concepts.description: A complete UMF model: its identity, vocabulary versions and modules.
concepts.title: Document

concepts.description: A namespace containing elements and declared relationships.
concepts.title: Module

concepts.description: A definition of named members. Its members reference Field definitions; its keys describe record identity.
concepts.title: Record

concepts.description: A named value slot. Describe a scalar, a collection, or a reference to a separate Record definition.
concepts.title: Field

concepts.description: An organizing element. The group role does not establish a record value shape.
concepts.title: Group

concepts.description: Recognized scalar families and the rules for unknown family labels.
concepts.title: Value types

concepts.description: Whether an ideal value may be absent. Native missing and null carriers need explicit bindings.
concepts.title: Nullability

concepts.description: One value, array items, or string-keyed map values.
concepts.title: Cardinality

concepts.description: Explicit bounds and refinements. Omission imposes no bound.
concepts.title: Facets

concepts.description: An ordered tuple of required singular Fields identifying a record within its collection.
concepts.title: Record identity Keys

concepts.description: Declared links between record populations, distinct from type references.
concepts.title: Relationships

concepts.description: Vocabulary-keyed metadata retaining independent native and authored meanings.
concepts.title: Extensions

propertyText.aliases: Alternative authored names; identities remain unchanged.
propertyText.allowedValues: Explicit allowed literals. Absence asserts no allowed-value list.
propertyText.cardinality: Field value shape: one, array, map or unspecified. Array and map containers cannot also assert scalarType.
propertyText.default: An explicit literal and the missing/null trigger on which default resolution is requested. Validation does not silently insert it.
propertyText.description: Human explanation of the authored meaning.
propertyText.element: Stable ID of the referenced element within that module.
propertyText.elements: Definitions carried by a module. Choose an explicit kind to state a UMF role.
propertyText.examples: Authored example values encoded using exact UMF literal carriers.
propertyText.extensions: Metadata keyed by vocabulary identifier. Unknown extension content is retained without inventing meaning.
propertyText.facets: Authored value refinements and bounds. Missing facets impose no bound; unknown qualifiers stay uninterpreted.
propertyText.fields: Ordered Field references making up the identity Key. Order is significant.
propertyText.id: Stable identity within the owning scope. Names and display titles do not replace it.
propertyText.itemType: Reference to the Field defining array items or map values. Requires kind field and cardinality array or map. Omission leaves item meaning unasserted.
propertyText.keys: Record identity declarations. Each key names an ordered tuple of owned, required singular Fields; this does not itself install native uniqueness enforcement.
propertyText.kind: The role of an element: field, record or group. Missing and unknown labels do not infer a role.
propertyText.members: References to the Fields belonging to a Record definition. These are the record’s data fields, distinct from this object’s own JSON keys.
propertyText.module: Stable ID of the module containing the reference target.
propertyText.name: A name in the model; distinct from stable id and display title.
propertyText.namespace: The module namespace; it does not automatically assert domain semantics.
propertyText.nullability: Ideal value availability for a Field. Required, absent-allowed and unspecified remain distinct; no native null carrier is implied.
propertyText.on: The explicit default trigger: missing, null or missing-or-null.
propertyText.primary: Marks the selected primary identity Key; at most one per Record.
propertyText.references: Role-qualified references to other elements. A record-type reference describes a Field’s Record value type, not relationship enforcement.
propertyText.relationships: Declared relationships owned by this module.
propertyText.role: Declared reference role; unknown roles retain their original labels.
propertyText.scalarType: The scalar value family. Recognized labels have UMF meaning; other nonempty labels remain retained with incomplete interpretation.
propertyText.semanticTypes: Version-qualified vocabulary term references. Native or external meaning is not inferred from a label alone.
propertyText.title: Display title for people reading the model.
propertyText.umf: Required document marker. Use the literal string 0.10.0.
propertyText.value: The literal value in its declared carrier, retaining exact numeric spelling.
propertyText.version: The exact independently versioned vocabulary declaration.
propertyText.vocabularies: Vocabulary identifiers mapped to exact independently versioned declarations.

scalarMeanings.binary: Binary values; native storage and encoding remain separate.
scalarMeanings.date: Date family; no implicit calendar operations are selected.
scalarMeanings.decimal: Exact decimal values; precision and scale are explicit refinements.
scalarMeanings.float: Floating-point value family; native precision and representation require explicit bindings.
scalarMeanings.integer: Whole-number values; width and signedness require explicit refinements.
scalarMeanings.string: Text values; native encoding and comparison rules are separate.
scalarMeanings.time: Time family; no implicit timezone is selected.
scalarMeanings.timestamp: Timestamp family; local versus instant semantics require explicit refinements.
scalarMeanings.uuid: An exact 16-byte UUID domain under umf-128/1; supported operations remain profile-qualified.
